name: Flag Pride
description: In the LGBTQ+ community, we signify our pride with flags. With many different identities in the community, there comes many different flags to know.The six color pride flag has represented the community for over 40 years and is still one of the most common LGBTQ+ flags.
notes: Outline and Mono are Fluent System Icons artwork, unmodified except for a currentColor rewrite. Standard is NOT shipped by Fluent — it is generated here by insetting the filled glyph in a gradient tile.
